relevantRecords.question: If a Unit or Legend with [DEFEATED] would be defeated but is prevented by an effect. Will I still get the [DEFEATED] effect?
If my Unit loses a fight but isn't defeated due to this effect, does it still count as losing the fight?

supported: Single next rival fight prevention leaves win/loss intact; independent of Program source in Trash; expires this turn. FAQ confirms loss remains and prevented defeat does not trigger DEFEATED.
unresolved: Whether both independent next-time effects consume on the same upcoming fight
Whether one remains for a later fight
Whether a redundant prevention is consumed after the first prevents defeat
decision: No pinned source specifically settles overlap. Replacement ordering rules do not establish whether these next-fight effects are replacements of defeat versus simultaneous fight-duration preventions. Keep explicit unsupported detector; do not guess.
